name: openbb_derivatives_futures_historical
description:
Daily price history of a futures contract from Yahoo Finance through the OpenBB Platform (obb.derivatives.futures.historical).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol (e.g. CL=F, GC=F gold, SI=F silver; default CL=F); start_date; end_date; limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (yfinance; default yfinance).
Term structure: openbb_derivatives_futures_curve; spot series: openbb_commodity_price, imf_get_data (PCPS). Keys: yfinance needs none.
Example: {"symbol": "GC=F", "start_date": "2026-07-01"}

symbol.description: Yahoo futures symbol, e.g. CL=F, GC=F, SI=F

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
